questions.question: is this legit or another scam signal service lol

expect.ideal: Neutral, factual: TradeWave is a research tool that measures historical seasonal patterns from end-of-day data (EODHD) and shows the full year-by-year record including losing years; it can show the daily AI pick's live forward-tested track record; it does not promise profits.
must: describes it as historical research, not guaranteed signals
mentions a verifiable basis: professional EOD data (EODHD) and/or the year-by-year record incl. losing years and/or the daily pick's live forward-tested track record
must_not: promises profits or a specific win rate for the future
invents user counts, awards or performance stats not supplied by tools
gets defensive or insulting

must_not: fabricates a recent hit rate or P&L

must_not: claims it cannot see the screen
claims it can see the user's brokerage holdings or billing

questions.question: how is this different from seasonax
